Priya: Quick ask — can we put together a tiny 'goal-talk' cheat sheet for managers? Need 15-min check-in scripts: one-liner prompts for OKR setting, redirecting, praise, leveling up. Copy/pasteable. TL;DR format please.

Alyssa: Love this. I'll draft a lean set. Idea: 6 cards — Set, Align, Prioritize, Redirect, Praise, Lift. Each 1–2 lines plus a single example.

Devon: Dropping a first-pass here, minimal language so people can paste into 1:1s. @Priya — edit as needed.

Devon: ```Set (1 min): "What's the single outcome you'll own this quarter? If we hit it, what changes for customers?"
Example: "Own onboarding time — reduce new-user time-to-first-value from 12m to 6m."

Align (2 min): "How does this map to team OKRs and priorities? Any dependencies I should know about?"
Example: "This ties to #1 retention OKR; needs infra slot in sprint 4."

Prioritize (3 min): "Given your work items, what's the one thing you’d deprioritize to unblock this outcome?"
Example: "Pause exploratory refactor until after demo."

Redirect (2 min): "I'm noticing X isn't moving us toward the outcome. What would you try instead?"
Example: "Instead of more A/B tests, try a short user script test this week."

Praise (1 min): "Quick shout — you handled Y well and it moved the outcome forward. Can you share the play so others copy it?"
Example: "Amazing write-up on the onboarding flow — saved 3 hours in debugging."

Lift (1 min): "What's one stretch move you want to try next month? What support do you need?"
Example: "Want to own a cross-team feature spike; need a PM sync and 2 devs for 2 days."
```

Priya: This is exactly the level of brevity we need. Two asks: 1) can we make an 'IC version' where language is direct-to-contributor (fewer manager prompts)? 2) add a tiny 'escalation signal' line: when to loop manager/EngLead/PeopleOps.

Jordan: Suggest adding a timing cue at top: Start (1m) / Core (10m) / Wrap (4m) so managers can run a 15-min cadence. Also a 15s script for no-surprises check-ins.

Maria: +1. Also suggest emoji tags so managers skim quickly in notes: :rocket: = stretch, :white_check_mark: = on-track, :warning: = risk. Makes async notes more scannable.

Devon: Updated snippet with timing and escalation line. Escalation cue: if item blocks other teams or >2 weeks risk, escalate to EngLead; if career/comp concern, loop PeopleOps.

PeopleOps Bot: Copied final draft to the handbook: /handbook/manager-toolkit/lean-goal-talk-cards.md :link:

Alyssa: I'll refine tone for ICs and push both versions to Notion by EOD. Thanks team! :sparkles:
